articles.title: Mayoral candidate Brad Bradford promises to prioritize the Scarborough East LRT if elected
articles.summary: Mayoral candidate Brad Bradford rolled out a major transit pledge Tuesday. Bradford promised to prioritize the Scarborough East LRT if he is elected. The line, formerly known as the Eglinton East LRT, has been in the works since 2009. Bradford claims that Olivia Chow has ignored the project during her term as mayor. CBC's Mercedes Gaztambide has the story.

articles.title: Motorcyclist dead after collision in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: A man in his 20s is dead after a motorcycle crash in Scarborough Tuesday afternoon, police said.

articles.title: U of T and workers' union reach tentative deal with university as classes begin
articles.summary: The University of Toronto and a union representing over 6,000 staff reached a tentative agreement Tuesday after three months of negotiations and a long weekend of bargaining.
